name: Qutub Minar
summary: The tallest brick minaret in the world, flanked by the ancient Iron Pillar and Alai Darwaza.
description: Built in the early 13th century, Qutub Minar rises 72.5 meters. The complex features exquisitely carved sandstone balconies and historic inscriptions.

name: Red Fort
summary: Historic fortified palace complex that served as the primary residence of Mughal Emperors.
description: Constructed in 1639 by Emperor Shah Jahan when he shifted his capital to Shahjahanabad. Famous for Diwan-i-Aam and Lahori Gate.

name: Humayun's Tomb
summary: Sublime garden tomb of Emperor Humayun that served as architectural inspiration for the Taj Mahal.
description: Commissioned by Empress Bega Begum in 1558, it is the first garden-tomb on the Indian subcontinent.
